title: Alone - Disabling mob generation
description: By enabling this datapack when creating the world, you will no longer encounter entities that were invoked when generating chunks. They can still be summoned by commands, summoning eggs or spawners, skulk screamers and some other ways.
body:
By enabling this datapack when creating the world, you will no longer encounter entities that were invoked when generating chunks. They can still be summoned by commands, summoning eggs or spawners, skulk screamers and some other ways.

It is also recommended to turn off structure generation.

This datapack is suitable for creators of various minigames or players who challenge themselves.
